\subsection*{Randomized --- BPTIMEThreshold: Results}

\begin{theorem}[Halting during rewind from a bounded position]
\lean{Randomized.Amplify.rewind_halts_pos}
\label{Randomized.Amplify.rewind_halts_pos}
\leanok
\uses{Randomized.Amplify.ACfg, Randomized.Amplify.Fresh, Randomized.Amplify.RewindAt, Randomized.Amplify.amp, Randomized.Amplify.halted_of_le, Randomized.Amplify.halts_comp_pos, Randomized.Amplify.restart, Randomized.Amplify.restart_eq_emb, Randomized.Amplify.rewindAt_emb, Randomized.Amplify.rewind_last, Randomized.Amplify.rewind_run_pos, Randomized.Amplify.step_emb, Turing.FinTM.moveInputPos_neg_val, Turing.NDTM.HaltsWithin, Turing.NDTM.initCfg, Turing.NDTM.runWith, Turing.NDTM.runWith_append, Turing.moveInputPos}
\difficulty{6}
Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over Boolean inputs, let $x$ be an
input, and let $r,t$ be natural numbers. Suppose every choice word of length exactly
$t$, run on $N$ from its initial configuration on $x$, ends in a halted configuration.
For every $i\in\mathbb N$ and $j$ with $0\le j\le r$ such that $j+i=r$, every counter
$c$ with $0\le c\le r+1$, and every augmented configuration $C$ in rewind phase at
$(j,c)$ with empty output and all later blocks blank with their heads at $0$, if the
input-head position of $C$ is at most $t+1$, then every choice word of length exactly
$i(2t+3)+1$ makes the amplified machine started from $C$ halt.
\end{theorem}

\begin{theorem}[Halting time with positive amplification parameter]
\lean{Randomized.Amplify.amp_haltsWithin_pos}
\label{Randomized.Amplify.amp_haltsWithin_pos}
\leanok
\uses{Randomized.Amplify.amp, Randomized.Amplify.fresh_init, Randomized.Amplify.halts_comp_pos, Randomized.Amplify.init_eq_emb, Randomized.Amplify.rewindAt_emb, Randomized.Amplify.rewind_halts_pos, Randomized.Amplify.step_emb, Turing.NDTM.HaltsWithin, Turing.NDTM.initCfg}
\difficulty{3}
Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic machine, let $r,t$ be natural numbers, let
$\mathrm{dec}:\mathbb{N}\to\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}$, and let $x$ be a Boolean
input word. If $N$ halts on $x$ after every choice word of length exactly $t$, then the
amplified machine with parameters $r$ and $\mathrm{dec}$ halts on $x$ after every choice
word of length exactly $t+r(2t+3)+1$.
\end{theorem}

\begin{theorem}[Output probability with positive amplification parameter]
\lean{Randomized.Amplify.amp_outputProb_pos}
\label{Randomized.Amplify.amp_outputProb_pos}
\leanok
\uses{Randomized.Amplify.acc, Randomized.Amplify.amp, Randomized.Amplify.amp_haltsWithin, Randomized.Amplify.amp_haltsWithin_pos, Randomized.Amplify.amp_outputProb, Randomized.blockCount, Randomized.randProb, Turing.FinNDTM.outputProb, Turing.FinNDTM.outputProb_eq_of_haltsWithin, Turing.NDTM.HaltsWithin}
\difficulty{1}
Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic machine with Boolean alphabet, let $r,t$ be natural
numbers, let $\mathrm{dec}:\mathbb{N}\to\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}$, let $x$ be a
Boolean input word, and let $v$ be a Boolean value. Suppose $N$ halts on $x$ for every
choice word of length exactly $t$. The probability that the amplified machine outputs
the one-symbol word $[v]$ after $t+r(2t+3)+1$ steps equals the probability that, for a
uniformly chosen Boolean word $l$ of length $(r+1)t$, applying $\mathrm{dec}$ to the
number of its $r+1$ consecutive blocks of length $t$ accepted by $N$ gives $v$.
\end{theorem}

\begin{theorem}[Monotonicity of time and success threshold]
\lean{Turing.FinNDTM.BPDecidesInTimeWith.mono}
\label{Turing.FinNDTM.BPDecidesInTimeWith.mono}
\leanok
\uses{Turing.FinNDTM, Turing.FinNDTM.BPDecidesInTimeWith, Turing.FinNDTM.outputProb_eq_of_haltsWithin, Turing.NDTM.HaltsWithin.mono}
\difficulty{3}
Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over the binary alphabet, let $L$ be
a language of binary strings, let $T_1,T_2\colon\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{N}$, and let
$p,q\colon\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{Q}$. Suppose $T_1(m)\le T_2(m)$ and $q(m)\le p(m)$ for
every $m$. If, on every input $x$, $N$ halts on every branch within $T_1(|x|)$ steps and
outputs the membership indicator for $L$ with probability at least $p(|x|)$, then it
halts within $T_2(|x|)$ steps on every branch and its corresponding output probability
is at least $q(|x|)$.
\end{theorem}

\begin{theorem}[Positive lower bound on halting time]
\lean{Turing.FinNDTM.BPDecidesInTimeWith.one_le}
\label{Turing.FinNDTM.BPDecidesInTimeWith.one_le}
\leanok
\uses{Turing.FinNDTM, Turing.FinNDTM.BPDecidesInTimeWith}
\difficulty{3}
Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over the binary alphabet, let $L$ be
a language of binary strings, let $T\colon\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{N}$, and let
$p\colon\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{Q}$. Suppose that on every input $x$, $N$ halts on every
branch within $T(|x|)$ steps and outputs the membership indicator for $L$ with
probability at least $p(|x|)$. Then $T(m)\ge 1$ for every $m\in\mathbb{N}$.
\end{theorem}

\begin{theorem}[Amplification of a probability guarantee]
\lean{Turing.FinNDTM.BPDecidesInTimeWith.amp}
\label{Turing.FinNDTM.BPDecidesInTimeWith.amp}
\leanok
\uses{Randomized.Amplify.amp, Randomized.Amplify.amp_haltsWithin_pos, Randomized.Amplify.amp_outputProb_pos, Randomized.Amplify.majority_randProb_ge, Turing.FinNDTM, Turing.FinNDTM.BPDecidesInTimeWith, Turing.FinNDTM.outputProb}
\difficulty{3}
Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over the binary alphabet, let $L$ be
a language of binary strings, let $t\colon\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{N}$, let
$\varepsilon\in\mathbb{Q}$ satisfy $0\le\varepsilon$, and let $n\in\mathbb{N}$. Suppose
that on every input $x$, $N$ halts on every branch within $t(|x|)$ steps and outputs the
membership indicator for $L$ with probability at least $1/2+\varepsilon$. The machine
formed by the specified amplification construction with parameter $2n$, using the
threshold that accepts at least $n+1$ positive votes among its $2n+1$ executions, halts
on every branch within $t(|x|)+2n(2t(|x|)+3)+1$ steps and outputs the membership
indicator for $L$ with probability at least $1-2(1-4\varepsilon^2)^n$ on every input
$x$.
\end{theorem}

\begin{definition}[Bounded-error time class]
\lean{Randomized.BPTIMEWith}
\statementsource{arora-barak-ch07-randomized-computation}{pdf-26d95080dbde-p002-b003}
\label{Randomized.BPTIMEWith}
\leanok
\uses{Turing.FinNDTM, Turing.FinNDTM.BPDecidesInTimeWith}
For $\rho\in\mathbb{Q}$ and a time bound $T:\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{N}$, the class consists
of languages $L$ for which there are a natural number $c$ and a finite nondeterministic
Turing machine $N$ such that $N$ decides $L$ within time $cT(n)$ with success parameter
constantly equal to $\rho$.
\end{definition}

    pdf-26d95080dbde-p002-b004}
For every time bound $T : \mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}$, the class of languages decidable
by a randomized machine in time bounded by a constant multiple of $T$, with acceptance
probability at least $2/3$ on members and rejection probability at least $2/3$ on
nonmembers, equals the corresponding class defined using the fixed success threshold
$2/3$.
\end{theorem}

\begin{theorem}[Monotonicity in the acceptance probability]
\lean{Randomized.BPTIMEWith_anti}
\label{Randomized.BPTIMEWith_anti}
\leanok
\uses{Randomized.BPTIMEWith, Turing.FinNDTM.BPDecidesInTimeWith.mono}
\difficulty{3}
Let $\rho',\rho\in\mathbb{Q}$ satisfy $\rho'\le\rho$, and let
$T:\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{N}$. Every language decidable by a randomized machine in time
bounded by a constant multiple of $T$ with acceptance probability at least $\rho$ on
every input is also decidable under the same time bound with acceptance probability at
least $\rho'$.
\end{theorem}

\begin{theorem}[Amplification of randomized decision probability]
\lean{Randomized.BPTIMEWith_subset_of_amp}
\label{Randomized.BPTIMEWith_subset_of_amp}
\leanok
\uses{Randomized.BPTIMEWith, Turing.FinNDTM.BPDecidesInTimeWith.amp, Turing.FinNDTM.BPDecidesInTimeWith.mono, Turing.FinNDTM.BPDecidesInTimeWith.one_le}
\difficulty{4}
Let $\varepsilon,\eta\in\mathbb{Q}$, with $0\le\varepsilon$, and let $n\in\mathbb{N}$
satisfy $2(1-4\varepsilon^2)^n\le\eta$. For every time bound
$T:\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{N}$, each language decidable in time bounded by a constant
multiple of $T$ with acceptance probability at least $\tfrac12+\varepsilon$ is also
decidable in time bounded by a constant multiple of $T$ with acceptance probability at
least $1-\eta$.
\end{theorem}
